howto.what_en: Claude walks you through six steps from a bare AKS cluster to a running model: verify the cluster and GPUs, install the controller, assess GPU constraints, pick an inference provider, then deploy and smoke-test a first model.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "airunway setup" and similar, or want the controller installed and a first model deployed. An existing AKS cluster is required.
